description: Spec 023 (phase 11, SRD Annex C §C.18, decision 39): T2's architecture and configuration (configs/phase4/b/tracker.json, id lstm-gaussian-re) trained from scratch on generator 0.6.0 data with realistic bearing error (seed 226, configs/phase7-ranges.json: Gauss-Markov 1.0 deg / 30 s plus a drifting bias 0.5 deg / 20 min). Normalisation from this dataset's train split (inputs only). The evaluation job only commits the model; validation (seed 217) and G8 (fresh seed 227) are scored with tma-g5 under a later decision that freezes both T2s by digest.
